title: Resume of a paused queue returns success while starting nothing for non-durability reasons
outcome: Resume of a paused queue returns success while starting nothing for non-durability reasons
acceptance: Each case in which resume_local_session_queue (src/session_lifecycle.rs) returns Ok while starting nothing on a non-empty paused queue is listed with its cause: Engram admission parked or held, boot recovery pending, a project-reset fence, and a busy session
For each case it is decided, with the coordinator's concurrence, whether the Resume should return an actionable reason instead of success, and any change is made with tests
